description: Header file defining the class 'complex_exponential_table' for generating and sampling complex sinusoid tables, used in signal processing within the 'ocudu' namespace.

classes.name: complex_exponential_table
classes.description: Class for creating and sampling a table of complex exponentials (sinusoids).

methods.name: complex_exponential_table
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the sinusoid table with specified size and amplitude.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the size of the sinusoid table.

methods.name: operator[]
methods.description: Accesses a specific coefficient from the sinusoid table by index.

methods.name: generate (span<cf_t> out, std::size_t initial, std::size_t frequency)
methods.description: Generates a complex sinusoid sequence based on initial index and frequency.

methods.name: generate (span<cf_t> out, span<const unsigned> in)
methods.description: Samples the sinusoid table at unsigned indices.

methods.name: generate (span<cf_t> out, span<const int> in)
methods.description: Samples the sinusoid table at signed indices.
